t: 2031 — First cable hulls product ships at scale: CNT yarns synthesis pr
title: 2031 — First cable hulls product ships at scale: CNT yarns synthesis pr
definition: 2031 milestone on the Nanotube Cable Systems roadmap.
description:
First cable hulls product ships at scale: CNT yarns synthesis proven outside the lab.

What must be true first: the CNT yarns results have to replicate outside the lab, cable logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and spinning scale operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed CNT yarns demonstrations, cable logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting spinning scale uptime. When all three flash green, 2031 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (5 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Nanotube Cable Systems
definition: Estimates Nanotube Cable Systems readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Nanotube Cable Systems components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a cable hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Nanotube Cable Systems operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Nanotube Cable Systems installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 94663 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where CNT yarns monitoring, cable logistics redundancy, or spinning scale maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Nanotube Cable Systems Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Nanotube Cable Systems: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Nanotube Cable Systems — cables woven from carbon nanotubes.

Phase 1 — Prove (CNT yarns): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (cable logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (spinning scale): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (conductivity): cable hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and power-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
